purpose: 三教师对照的费用守卫用价目表。**只收已核验的价**；未核验的条目让守卫失败关闭。
rule: 任何 candidate 的 price_verified 不为 true 时，守卫必须拒绝为它发送计费请求。
currency_note: 各平台按**自己的计价币种**报数；跨币种换算必须显式声明汇率与来源，不得默认。

source.title: Models & Pricing | DeepSeek API Docs
source.verbatim_excerpt: MODEL deepseek-flash ... Vision ✓ ... PRICING (2) 1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE HIT) OFF-PEAK $0.003 PEAK $0.006 ; 1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE MISS) OFF-PEAK $0.15 PEAK $0.3 ; 1M OUTPUT TOKENS OFF-PEAK $0.6 PEAK $1.2
source.verbatim_note_2: Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. All other hours are off-peak, including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.

deepseek.conservative_assumption: 守卫按 **peak + cache_miss** 计价（最坏情况），不假设缓存命中或低峰。
